media:group.media:description:
Hello! My name is Logan and I am a Student Teacher Music Education major in my late semester. During all of this I would like to take the time to say haw privileged I am. My worries feel so small in the grand scheme of what is happening in the world. I hope that we can all continue to work together for the betterment of our world! Please enjoy this light hearted video!
Darin Nakakihara https://www.youtube.com/darinnakakihara and Marie Morris (The Caffeinated Classroom) https://www.youtube.com/channel/UCX0-...
